findings.summary: Task 13's manual check launches serve without --signed-in, so clicking Listen opens AuthModal rather than the promised ListenModal; seed the signed-in fixture for this check.

The font grep cannot return no files after Tasks 3–5 because it includes tokens.css, where Task 2 explicitly requires the three literal font-family names; exclude the token definitions from this acceptance check.

The unrestricted hex grep includes tokens.test.mjs and existing SVG assets, which intentionally retain hex literals, so its expected tokens.css-only result is impossible without matching Task 6's extension exclusions.

The manual share-export check cannot run as prescribed because vite preview serves neither the Playwright network fixtures nor the invalid fixture Supabase host, and Task 4 also precedes creation of the v4 brand; provide an interactive fixture mode and schedule both-brand export verification after the brand exists.
